description: Live vehicle positions: the latest fresh ping per vehicle, replaced by the poller after every poll (about every 10 s). Written by poller/, read by the frontend planner. Positions are the city API's own public data.
encoding: gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSON, Content-Type application/gzip, Cache-Control no-cache

fields.updated_at: UTC ISO timestamp with Z suffix: when this object was built
fields.columns: array of column names, exactly as listed under vehicle_columns
fields.vehicles: array of rows, one per vehicle, each an array in columns order

vehicle_columns.brigade: API Brigade value, a string as sent (may carry leading zeros)
vehicle_columns.vehicle: API VehicleNumber, a string; unique within mode

invariants: every row's time is at most MAX_PING_AGE_SECONDS (default 300) before updated_at
a mode whose polls fail keeps its last rows until they age out; an empty vehicles array is valid
rows are sorted by mode, then vehicle
